name: edr_get_host
description: Return the EDR record for one host: role, criticality, owner team, isolation state, open alerts. Read-only. Call before any containment action so preconditions are in context.

host_id.description: Absolute EDR host identifier, e.g. host-4471

name: edr_isolate_host
description: Network-isolate ONE host for a bounded time. Semi-reversible, single-object, production control. The server releases the isolation automatically when ttl_minutes expires. Domain controllers cannot be isolated with this tool. Requires the five-question intent.
